CURRENT SCENE:
古代的时候，有很多人不知道什么植物能吃，什么植物不能吃。有很多人吃植物以后就吃坏肚子了，因为他们吃了毒。那个时候，有一个老人叫神农，他什么植物都觉得好吃，不怕生病，不怕毒。他希望别人也可以吃好吃的植物。可是他知道，如果他们还怕吃毒，不会吃他喜欢的植物。

ITEMS:

[I321] 【古代的时候】   correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 古代的时候 -> 在古代 (corrected 18/30 in train)
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]

[I322] 什【么】植物不能吃   correction: 么 → 麼   strength: suggestion
  rule card (cause_result_soyi, Coherence: connectors): Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the following event is not a result of the preceding clause, so 所以 is not appropriate; use <connector> / delete it.  Her terms: 这样, 结果, 后来
  her past correction: [因为→这样]大家知道什么植物不能吃 — her note: not “because”
  her past correction: 他们不知道什么植物[-能吃]不能吃
  her past correction: 大家不知道什么[菜→植物]能吃

[I323] 因为他们吃了【毒】   correction: 毒 → 有毒的植物   strength: error
  checker's note: people eat poisonous plants, not simply “poison”
  rule card (word_class_choice, Vocabulary): Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: here the structure needs a <required word class/form>, but <wrong word/form> is a <wrong word class/form>.  Her terms: noun, Adj., Subj., 很多+noun, 这个 + Noun
  her past correction: 他们吃[毒→有毒的]植物
  her past correction: 哪些植物是[毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 什么植物[是毒→有毒]

[I324] 他【什么植物都觉得】好吃   correction: 什么植物都觉得 → 觉得什么植物都   strength: error
  checker's note: 觉得 should come before its object clause
  rule card (expressive_detail_and_description, Other): Add specific descriptive detail, such as what kind, how much, or how often, when it makes the scene clearer and less like a bare sequence of events.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: add <detail> to make <thing/action> more specific and expressive.
  her past correction: [植物→一种绿色的植物]他觉得好吃得很
  her past correction: 神农[什么想尝→想尝什么植物]
  her past correction: 他们不知道什么植物[-能吃]不能吃

[I325] 【^】不怕毒   correction: ∅ → 也   strength: suggestion
  rule card (verb_object_valency, Grammar): Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <verb/verb phrase> must take <the allowed object or complement structure>; <brief reason, such as “it is a V.+Obj. compound” or “the action is durative, so use 着durative”>.  Her terms: 着durative, 跑遍 + place, 管事V.+Obj. compound, 掉 + directional + place, resultative complement

  rule card (resultative_complements, Grammar): Use a resultative complement when the action reaches its result: 吃到, 写下, 撞到+Obj., or 把Obj. V. Resultative complement.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the action reaches a result, so use <resultative complement>.  Her terms: 吃到result, 写下, 撞到+Obj., 把Obj. V. Resultative complement

If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the following event is not a result of the preceding clause, so 所以 is not appropriate; use <connector> / delete it.  Her terms: 这样, 结果, 后来

items.explanation: 古代 is the setting, so use 在+Place before the sentence: 在古代.
It would be more natural to use the traditional character 麼 here: 什麼植物不能吃.
Here people eat a noun, not simply 毒. Use 有毒的植物 for “poisonous plants.”
觉得 should come before the clause it describes. Say 觉得什么植物都好吃.
It would be more natural to add 也 to connect the two similar ideas: 不怕生病，也不怕毒.
It would be more natural to use 吃到result because the people succeed in finding and eating the tasty plants.
Use 吃到result for reaching the result of eating, and say 有毒的植物 rather than 吃毒.
It would be more natural to add 就 after 如果 to show the result of the condition.
